overall: The AG found that the Board, acting as the North Brookfield Railroad Company Board of Directors, is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it manages a private company rather than serving a public purpose, so no violation occurred; the Board was encouraged to keep complying voluntarily.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violates the Open Meeting Law when it acts as the Board of Directors of the North Brookfield Railroad Company.
allegations.key_passage: However, the NBRC Board's function is to manage a private company, rather than serve a public purpose
